purpose: Build a consented passive preview for one user-selected window without enumerating windows or intercepting input.

entities.role: Microsoft GraphicsCapturePicker official documentation and Windows UI Composition Win32 sample

activities.label: compile the passive selected-window preview with the official Windows CppWinRT package
verify picker consent, no enumeration, no raw persistence and no input interception
record that interactive external-window evidence remains pending

queries.expression: does the preview require explicit system selection before a capture session starts
does the preview avoid external enumeration, raw persistence and input interception
has a real user-selected application produced and sustained a preview frame

assumptions: The picker is called on the owner UI thread as required by the Windows API.
The preview is a separate window and does not replace or cover the source.
The CPU readback is diagnostic only and is not the production renderer.
No interactive external-window run is claimed in this record.
kill_tests: Canceling the picker does not start capture.
The preview source is never selected by title or foreground-window guessing.
No input is injected or intercepted for the selected source.
No raw frame is written to disk.
The unexecuted runtime is not labeled as verified.
unknowns: Whether the selected application delivers frames on this machine after consent.
What frame cadence and latency are observed for a real external window.
How source closure and resize should version the preview.
Whether a selected window can later support a safe semantic region map.
